settings_wall_remembered: Remembered in this browser. The Backdrop and Theme buttons on the wall change the same choices.
settings_wall_scene_help: The city drawn behind the board. Auto picks the closest one to this browser's time zone; None keeps a plain board. A link can still ask for another city with ?city=.
settings_wall_theme_help: Night is the default. Day lights Paris; the other cities are only drawn at night. A link can ask for one with ?theme=.
status_form_scene_help_default: An illustrated city behind the title of the public page. Without a choice the page shows Paris; tick Simple mode for a plain page. Tick several to alternate between them.
status_form_scene_none_default: Nothing ticked: the page shows Paris
wall_scene_world_hint: Auto picks the closest city to this display's time zone. None keeps a plain board.
wall_theme_forced: A link set this one for right now; it is not saved here.
wall_theme_night_only: This city is drawn at night only.
